faqs.question: What is AICE Services and what do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: AICE Services is an AI-driven civil engineering consultancy. We combine hands-on engineering reviews with cutting-edge AI tools to deliver audit-ready reports, hydraulic models, BOQ discrepancy audits, and donor-compliant designs for ADB, World Bank, and government infrastructure projects.

faqs.question: How do your solutions ensure compliance with ADB and World Bank standards?
faqs.answer: Our deliverables adhere strictly to international donor guidelines, FIDIC contract conditions, and local statutory codes (such as PHED, WASA, and PPRA). Our engineering team performs rigorous multi-stage audits to guarantee that designs and documentation are tender- and audit-ready.

faqs.question: What are the core AI tools built by AICE Services?
faqs.answer: We have developed specialized utilities including AICEMark (converts AI markdown to native Word .docx with KaTeX formula support), AICE Deck Edit (transforms flat NotebookLM slides into editable PPTX), and AICE ProScan (OCR and automated BOQ discrepancy auditing).

faqs.question: How does AICEMark help when working with AI tools?
faqs.answer: When copying responses from AI chatbots, tables and math equations often break in Microsoft Word. AICEMark repairs malformed syntax on the fly and exports clean, publication-grade Word documents with editable equations.

faqs.question: Can AICE Services build custom AI applications for our firm?
faqs.answer: Yes! We design bespoke private AI engines, document scrapers, and workflow automation tailored specifically for civil engineering consultants, contractors, and government agencies.

faqs.question: How can we schedule a consultation or get a proposal?
faqs.answer: You can book an appointment directly through this assistant, click the WhatsApp button to chat directly with our engineering team (+92 301 3666088), or email us at contact@aiceservices.com.
